roles.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Vice President of Product-Product Agentic Platform, AI & Product Office owns the office's hardest and most ambiguous product bets, helping the Chief AI & Product Officer (CAIPO) drive Optum Health's enterprise AI-enabled product strategy, Agenix solutions portfolio and product capability agenda. Serving as strategist, builder and owner of the outcome, this role defines the problem with the people who do the work, decides what gets built and why and takes each product from first prototype through deployment and measurement. This role focuses on building a secure, governed and reusable agentic platform that enables product teams to develop, evaluate, deploy and monitor AI agents at enterprise scale.

This individual is accountable for measurable enterprise value: whether what shipped changed care for patients and care teams, whether it did so appropriately and whether it earns the return required to scale. The VP of Product keeps the work focused on the smallest version that can prove or disprove a bet, and brings clinical, operational, technology and governance partners into one team rather than a chain of handoffs.

This is a job for a builder. The team is just starting, and you will help build it and shape how it innovates, at the highest level. The office is small today, and that is by design: its leverage is the enterprise AI investment it drives across Optum Health. You will write, prototype and analyze with AI tools every day, and you will be where care is delivered, not only in meetings about it.

The AI & Product Office is building a small, cross-functional product team: product management, engineering, product design, service design, deployment and clinical, working alongside care team members from each local market team. The team embeds with a local Optum Health market team to find problems with the people who do the work, then design, build, deploy and measure the products that fix them. What the team learns in the first market is written down as the method for the next one.

If you are located in MA, you will have the flexibility to work remotely* as you take on some tough challenges.

Senior Director, Software Engineering - AI

As a Capital One Senior Director of Software Engineering,  you’ll spearhead our AI initiatives, developing and managing elite technical teams to architect next-generation intelligent solutions. You will champion everything from enterprise LLM orchestration and generative AI pipelines integrated into web/mobile frontends, to high-throughput, low-latency microservices for real-time model inference. You'll bring deep expertise in scaling production-grade machine learning systems and traditional architectures.

At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will foster a culture of engineering excellence and inclusivity, balancing technical depth with empowered team leadership. You will lead the way in building next-generation talent for Capital One Tech—mentoring managers and engineers, driving workforce strategy and actively recruiting top-tier talent.

Senior Directors are expected to lead through technical vision, operational rigor and strategic alignment. You will serve as a key owner for your domain's technical health, delivery velocity and system resilience. While shaping long-term technology strategy and platform roadmaps, you will inspire a culture of continuous learning, innovation and high-impact delivery across your organization.

You will:
- Lead, manage, and scale multiple high-performing teams of AI and machine learning focused software engineers to drive our AI initiatives.
- Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of engineers, cultivating deep expertise in MLOps, LLM architecture, and advanced data science practices.
- Partner with product managers and data scientists to translate desired intelligent application capabilities, model validation strategies, and evaluation frameworks into production-ready software.
- Continuously mature AI engineering practices, championing robust frameworks for model lineage, continuous training (CT), and secure, ethical AI deployment.
- Collaborate within and across Agile teams to architect, train, test, implement, and support scalable technical solutions across full-stack AI and distributed cloud technologies.
- Lead the technical craftsmanship, model reproducibility, low-latency availability, and enterprise-grade scalability of your intelligent solutions.

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)

- At least 9 years of experience in software engineering and solution architecture

As a Principal AI Transformation Engineer , you will lead the strategic transformation and modernization of Citi’s Credit Risk Monitoring platforms—converting traditional UIs, manual analytical workflows, and legacy operational business processes into intelligent, AI-driven autonomous systems.

This pivotal role sits at the intersection of enterprise risk architecture and cutting-edge Generative AI. You will design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, custom LLM tools, prompt architectures, and intelligent conversational/generative interfaces that empower risk officers to monitor limit breaches, detect early warning indicators (EWIs), and orchestrate counterparty risk actions in real time.

This role requires deep hands-on engineering involvement (≥50% coding/prototyping), combining robust enterprise software engineering standards with state-of-the-art GenAI, Agentic orchestration frameworks, and system-level API/data integrations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. AI Stack Uplift, Agentic Systems & MCP Engineering (Hands-on ≥50%)
- Agentic Workflows & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and build autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, decomposing complex credit risk tasks, querying risk databases, and executing end-to-end monitoring actions with human-in-the-loop governance.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Tool Development: Design and implement robust MCP servers and secure API tool connectors that expose internal risk services, data stores, calculation engines, and third-party financial telemetry to LLMs and AI agent frameworks.
- Prompt Engineering & Context Optimization: Develop, benchmark, and maintain production-grade prompt pipelines, dynamic context retrieval mechanisms, system personas, few-shot strategies, and structured output schemas (e.g., JSON mode / Pydantic validation).
- Evaluation, Guardrails & Observability: Implement enterprise AI guardrails (evaluating hallucination, toxicity, faithfulness, and PII masking), latency/token cost optimizations, and comprehensive tracing/observability for all LLM calls and agent execution trees.

2. UI Modernization & Process Transformation

- Rapid Prototyping & Co-Creation: Partner directly with Credit Risk Analysts, Product Managers, and UX designers to rapidly build and validate Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), testing innovative AI capab

ABOUT THE TEAM

Applied AI Engineering helps customers build, deploy, and run useful AI systems with OpenAI products. We work alongside customer engineers and technical partners, and bring what we learn back to Product and Research.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll lead AIE for SMB and Mid-Market customers globally. The opportunity is to make engineering support effective across a broad customer base: choose where direct involvement matters most, help customers reach production, and make successful approaches easier to repeat across regions.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Build and develop a customer-facing engineering team, set clear standards, and keep ownership close to the work.

 - Agree coverage and priorities with regional Sales and Applied AI Architecture (AAA) leaders; make explicit choices about dedicated and scaled support.

 - Turn recurring deployment problems into reusable implementations, evaluations, tooling, and delivery practices.

 - Set a practical bar for model quality, reliability, safety, latency, and cost, and help the team resolve difficult technical decisions.

 - Measure sustained production use and customer value, and use the evidence to improve where the organization spends its time.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have led customer-facing engineering teams with responsibility for people, technical quality, and production delivery.

 - Can make sound decisions about AI applications and explain the trade-offs to engineers, customers, and commercial partners.

 - Have helped an organization serve a broad portfolio through repeatable practices while preserving depth where it matters.

 - Have made difficult hiring, performance, and resource decisions, and can show how your leadership improved others’ effectiveness.

 - Work well across regions and build trust while resolving competing customer and business priorities.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

roles.description:
Are you interested in growing your career in Cyber Security?

Whether you are an application developer or researcher looking to make the switch into the challenging, yet rewarding, world of information security, or you are an elite white-hat hacker, Citi is the place for you. Our team of world class, talented individuals, who are passionate about security, put their skills to the test every day on a global scale. At Citi, you will be exposed to all sorts of technologies on an enterprise-scale, so hunger for knowledge and research is greatly appreciated and rewarded.

Technology is constantly evolving, and Citi is evolving with it by adopting the latest application frameworks, migrating to cloud-based technologies, and implementing Artificial Intelligence in numerous workflows across the enterprise. Citi’s application penetration testing team is at the forefront of testing and securing each of these solutions and you can make an impact on the next technology to be released.

This team specializes in conducting various types of penetration testing engagements (full end-to-end white-box and/or grey-box testing) against a variety of Citi owned or 3rd party SaaS applications (Web, Mobile, Thick Client, and APIs) leveraging a wide array of technologies from Artificial Intelligence, to Digital Assets, Blockchain, and more traditional application development frameworks. The primary goal would be to secure Citi, its customers, and clients by manually identifying, researching, validating, and exploiting application security weaknesses and misconfigurations.

Core responsibilities include:

-
- Plan, scope, and execute comprehensive penetration tests against blockchain networks, smart contracts, decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, and digital asset custody systems.
- Perform manual and automated source code reviews of smart contracts written in Solidity, Rust, Go, or Vyper to identify logic flaws, reentrancy, front-running, flash loan vulnerabilities, and integer overflows.
- Act as a subject matter expert in offensive information security performing dynamic and manual security assessments on web technologies such as APIs, JavaScript Frameworks, Artificial Intelligence, and Distributed Ledger Technologies.
- Drive remediation by outlining a defense-in-depth approach to business stakeholders and providing strategic solutions to developers on effective preventive and detective security controls.
- Have strong technical writing and presentation skills to report and articulate the vulnerability assessment results to any audience.
- Contribute to the review of internal processes and activities and assist in identifying potential opportunities for improvement and automation.
- Conduct research into emerging attack vectors, zero-day exploits, and novel vulnerabilities unique to Web3 and digital asset ecosystems
- Must have or be willing to obtain Industry-accredited security certifications such as: BSCP, GWAPT, GPEN, OSCP, OSWE, CISSP, or other related certifi

Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.




About the Role

Owns datacenter design and technical standards for Lambda’s AI infrastructure. Sets the basis of design, builds a repeatable and scalable set of reference designs, and leads the design team that delivers efficient, reliable, buildable facilities for current and next-generation GPU platforms.


What You’ll Do

Basis of design and standards

 - Own Lambda’s datacenter basis of design: electrical topology, mechanical and cooling options, and building architecture.

 - Maintain standard building modules and reference designs that scale across site sizes and capacities using a common equipment set.

 - Run design change control and manage approved deviations so designs stay consistent across regions.

AI infrastructure readiness

 - Ensure designs support current and upcoming GPU cabinet power and cooling densities, including liquid cooling and high-density row distribution.

 - Coordinate regularly with GPU, server, and networking partners so facility designs stay flexible across platform generations.

 - Drive efficiency (PUE), reliability, constructability, and cost in every design decision.

Site master planning and design delivery

 - Lead site master planning for candidate and new sites, working with Power and Site Development on power and land constraints.

 - Direct third-party architecture and engineering firms through concept, schematic, and construction documents against schedule and budget.

 - Drive prefabrication and modular delivery with Construction and the supply chain.

Equipment specification

 - Own owner-furnished equipment specifications and required equipment lists; review and approve vendor proposals and submittals.

 - Support long-lead equipment forecasting with Construction and procurement.

Team and quality

 - Lead the Mechanical Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Architect, and TPM; set design review and quality processes and hire as the portfolio grows.

 - Ensure code compliance and professional engineering oversight of design deliverables.

You

 - 15+ years designing critical facilities or datacenters, including 5+ years leading design teams.

 - Hands-on depth in mechanical (chilled water, heat rejection, liquid cooling) and electrical design for large-scale datacenters.

 - Experience developing design standards and reference designs for multi-site programs.

 - Experience managing third-party architecture and engineering firms and design budgets.

 - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, or architecture; licensed Professional Engineer strongly preferred.

Nice to Have

**Organization:** National Nonprofit Organization  
**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer  
**Department:** Technology  
**Work Location:** Remote  
**Employment Status:** Regular, Full-Time, Exempt  
**Position Level:** Executive / Senior Leadership  
**Salary Range:** $225,000–$250,000 annually

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**

We are a national nonprofit organization committed to advancing our mission through innovative programs, strategic partnerships, and technology-enabled services. We work with diverse stakeholders across the country to deliver programs, strengthen operations, and achieve meaningful outcomes.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Chief Technology Officer to lead our technology function, strengthen operational performance, and guide the continued evolution of our technology infrastructure and digital platforms.

This is an opportunity to join our executive leadership team and play a critical role in shaping our technology strategy, strengthening our systems and capabilities, and ensuring technology supports our organizational mission and long-term priorities.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) serves as our senior technology executive and technical authority, with overall accountability for enterprise technology strategy, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and technology delivery.

This is a hands-on executive leadership role requiring a combination of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, business acumen, and operational leadership. The CTO directly supervises the technology team, provides technical direction, oversees production changes, and ensures the reliability, security, and performance of our critical systems.

The position combines responsibilities often distributed across an engineering manager, vice president of engineering, and chief technology officer. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable making complex technical decisions, leading a multidisciplinary team, developing long-term technology strategies, and advising executive leadership on investments, operational risks, and organizational priorities.

The CTO leads a team of employees and contractors responsible for enterprise applications, digital platforms, data and reporting systems, cloud infrastructure, and internal IT operations. The role carries direct accountability for the availability, performance, security, and continued modernization of business-critical systems.

**POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Executive Leadership and Accountability:** Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, advising the CEO and senior leaders on technology strategy, investments, risks, and opportunities. Translate complex technical matters into business implications and contribute to organizational strategy, resource planning, and executive and board discussions.
* **Team Leadership and Supervision:** Directly supervise engineering, analysis, and IT staff

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

Citi Wealth is seeking a highly experienced Senior AI/ML Engineering hands on senior engineer of enterprise-grade GenAI and agent-based solutions. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and scaling LLM-powered systems using modern agent frameworks, including ADK (Agent Development Kit), while ensuring compliance with risk, governance, and regulatory standards.

The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise in AI engineering with strong understanding of financial services, ML, and enterprise controls, and will partner across Technology, Product, Risk, and Compliance teams.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop LLM-powered applications and agentic systems using frameworks such as LangChain and ADK (Agent Development Kit)
- Build and manage multi-agent orchestration, tool chaining, and workflow automation
- Develop robust guardrails (input/output validation) to ensure safe and compliant AI behavior
- Integrate AI solutions with enterprise APIs, data platforms, and internal systems
- Design real-time and asynchronous AI pipelines (REST APIs, streaming, WebSockets)
- Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Model Governance teams

Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Technical Program Managers who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.

As a Director of Technical Program Management (TPM), we’re looking for someone that can help us lead programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale products & platforms that will help Capital One customers have incredible experiences.

In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to teach the organization what a great TPM can achieve.

Visit our website for more information: http://www.hbs.edu/information-technology/about-us .

Can you see yourself setting the direction that takes the School’s technology toward an AI-enabled future? If so, consider joining our team! Building and sustaining influence requires strong, collaborative relationship building with HBS IT leadership and staff, and with senior administrators across HBS. The Managing Director leads a team of architects responsible for HBS’s administrative and academic technology architecture and nurtures an agile team culture.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architectural lead

**Director of Data Platform & Engineering**

**About Us**

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Director of Data Platform & Engineering to own everything upstream of the business: the ingestion, warehouse, orchestration, and data infrastructure that every report, partner data feed, and agentic AI product at Gifthealth depends on. This position plays a key role in supporting the Data Platform & Engineering team (not labeled as a formal department in the source job description) and reports to the CTO, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards.

Peers in this role include the Director of Data & Analytics, Director of Engineering, Director of IT, and Director of IT Security. The team today is a small, senior data engineering group with a platform mandate and room to grow, covering ingestion, warehouse, orchestration, data infrastructure, and the staging and intermediate dbt layers.

You'll lead the engineers who build and run our Snowflake warehouse, Fivetran and custom ingestion, the foundational dbt layers, and the orchestration around it, and you'll be hands-on enough to review a dbt model, read a slow query plan, or debug a failed load when it matters.

The bigger reason this role exists is the seam between software engineering and data. Our product and platform engineers ship GifthealthOS and our hub services every day, including the real-time partner integrations that drive operational workflows. Our data team turns what those systems produce into analytics, partner deliverables, and AI inputs. Nobody owns the handoff between them today. You will: the data contracts, change data capture, schema change discipline, and shared onboarding and monitoring standards that let the two sides work as one system. Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.

We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.

Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in  this letter from our founders .

Why This Role Matters

The Head of IT Security will lead our security operations to help build a world-class IT organization ready to tackle Pacific Fusion's growing technical needs. This role plays a critical part in supporting our distributed workforce across California and New Mexico with reliable and secure communication infrastructure. By establishing robust security practices across hardware R&D labs, manufacturing lines, and cloud environments, you will ensure our sensitive data, supply chain, hardware assets, and advanced fusion research intellectual property remain fully protected against sophisticated threats.

- Supply chain, vendors & defense partners. Secure our hardware supply chain against tampering and espionage, review the security of new vendors, tools, hardware components, and service providers, and work with government cybersecurity programs, defense insurers, and security partners.
- Program support. Draft policy updates from operational findings for Head of IT approval, coordinate evidence for audits and insurer assessments, and prioritize competing security requests.
- Resilience, awareness and team. Run incident tabletops, contribute to continuity planning, run security awareness and phishing programs, and mentor engineers from day one, handing them ownership of technical areas as they grow.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

 - Engineer the systems behind one of the world's largest compute buildouts. Everything runs as code, version-controlled and reproducible, so a new hire, team, or site spins up in minutes instead of days.  - Give every employee the speed it takes to reach 10s of GW. The faster the company's people move, the faster we get to 10s of GW. You'll own the internal systems and support that keep a 10x workforce unblocked.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own corporate IT end to end: identity, endpoint fleet, SaaS estate, and employee support for a workforce that grew 10x in the last year.

 - Stand up IT at each new data center site as it comes online, and keep a growing multi-state fleet of live sites supported while construction continues around them.

The San Francisco Health Network, Population Health, Behavioral Health Services, and Administration are the core divisions of SFDPH. At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we're revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

**About the Role:**

The Director of the Security Operations Center owns detection, response, and threat hunting across our production, corporate, and cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the direction of the SOC in line with the CISO's security strategy and run a team of senior technical professionals day to day. When an incident calls for it, you will step in personally and lead the investigation and response. You report directly to the CISO and act as their operational partner, so the CISO always has an accurate picture of threats, exposure, and our ability to respond.

**What you will do:**

* Turn the CISO's security strategy into a SOC roadmap, prioritize where detection and response investment goes, and show measurable progress against it.
* Own the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle, from telemetry collection through detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and corrective action.
* Act as incident commander for the highest-severity events. Get hands-on in the investigation, analyze logs, endpoint, network, identity, and cloud telemetry yourself, and make containment decisions under pressure.
* Build, lead, and develop a team of incident response, detection, and threat hunting engineers. Set a high technical bar, coach people through hard investigations, and hold the team accountable for quality and follow-through.
* Hold your ground on technical and risk decisions with engineering, product, IT, and executive stakeholders. Push back with evidence when a decision increases exposure, and escalate clearly when needed.
* Design and evolve the SOC architecture, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, identity, and cloud detection tooling. Decide what to build, what to buy, and what to retire.
* Drive an automation-first operating model that cuts manual triage, shortens time to detect and contain, and lets the team scale without adding headcount in step with the environment.
* Establish full telemetry coverage across the Compass platform, including acquired environments, so that every critical asset produces attributable, correlated events.
* Lead a threat-informed defense program. Use adversary behavior, threat intelligence, and hunting results to drive detection engineering and active defense capabilities.
* Own the incident response plan, severity definitions, escalation paths, and on-call model. Run realistic tabletop and live-fire exercises that include technical teams and executives.
* Run blameless post-incident reviews and make sure corrective actions have an identified owner, a deadline, and verified completion.
* Define and report the operational metrics that matter, such as coverage, detection fidelity, dwell time,

When you join Imprivata, you embark on a shared journey of ambition and growth. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. If you’re looking for a place to match your passion with purpose—and where every day you can make an impact—you’ll find it here.

We are seeking a **Director, DevSecOps and Application Security** to join our team. This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our Waltham, MA office.

**Job Summary**

LevelBlue reduces risk and builds lasting resilience so organizations can innovate and advance their mission with confidence. As the world’s most analyst-recognized and largest pure-play managed security services provider, LevelBlue elevates client outcomes that matter: stronger defense, faster response, and sustained business continuity. LevelBlue combines AI-powered security operations, advanced threat intelligence, and elite human expertise to provide the most comprehensive portfolio of strategic advisory, managed security, offensive security, and incident response services.
  
Our Security Testing team is a distributed group of about 55 offensive security professionals in the Americas who deliver challenging, high-impact assessments for clients around the world. We offer a healthy combination of autonomy and senior-level support. The team publishes security research and blogs, delivers conference talks, builds and shares tooling, and invests in continuous learning.
  
Cyber Technical Director
  
The Cyber Technical Director is the most senior technical leader and people leader within LevelBlue’s Security Testing practice. This is a hands-on technical leadership role delivering the most demanding engagements, advancing our research and tooling, and helping raise the skills of the entire team. We want technical people leading technical people: in addition to performing client engagements, you will mentor teammates, perform technical reviews of their work, and help advance the technical direction of our offerings.
  
We are especially looking to deepen our capabilities in areas such as AI/GenAI application security testing (including breaking out of guardrails and attacking LLM-powered and agentic applications), Red Teaming, and stealthy internal network penetration testing. Expertise with cloud security assessments, source code reviews, architecture reviews / threat modeling, and thick-client application testing will also be considered. You will help build our expertise across the team while supporting high-value client engagements.
  
Candidates should be well versed in client-facing consulting skills. Candidates must be able to balance workload in a remote work environment, and work effectively and jointly with colleagues within the ever-growing team worldwide.
  
  
**Specific Responsibilities:**  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of security consultants as their people leader, including performance management, career development, and participation in recruiting and hiring.
* Set technical direction and methodology for the team’s services, with a particular focus on one or both of AI/GenAI application testing (prompt injection, guardrail bypass, data and tool abuse in LLM-powered and agentic applications) and Red Teaming (including compromise simulations and stealthy internal network penetration testing).
* Personally deliver and oversee complex engagements across AI/GenAI application testing, Red Team operations, external/internal network

Fairbanks Morse Defense builds and supports the engines, power systems, and mechanical systems that keep Navy and Coast Guard ships underway. Our technology organization develops the next generation of those products, modernizes the equipment already in the fleet, and guides where FMD invests across its product lines.
  
We are hiring a Director of Technology to lead that organization. You will own three things: technology development and internal R&D investment, the retrofit and upgrade business that modernizes in-service engines and systems, and product portfolio management across FMD. You will set the technology roadmap, lead the engineering and product teams that deliver it, and report to the Sr. Vice President of Strategic Projects.
  
This role is remote, leading a team out of Beloit Wisconsin, with approximately 35% travel to FMD facilities, customer sites, shipyards, and test sites.
  
Why This Role
  

* The full technology lifecycle. You own products from early R&D through military qualification, fielding, and in-service upgrade.
* A fleet that needs modernizing. FMD engines and systems are installed across the Navy, Coast Guard, and Military Sealift Command fleets. Your retrofit and upgrade programs extend their service life, improve readiness, and solve obsolescence.
* A portfolio view across FMD. You see every product line in the company and shape where FMD invests, and sustains.
* Customer and executive access. You work directly with Navy technical authorities, program offices, and research sponsors, and with FMD’s executive team and business leaders.
* A mission that matters. Your products help keep global naval and coast guard vessels powered, ready, and supported.

* Technology Strategy & Development
* Define and maintain FMD’s technology roadmap for power, propulsion, controls, and digital sustainment products, aligned to Global Navy’s, Coast Guard’s, and other customers priorities.
* Own the internal R&D (IRAD) portfolio: select projects, set gates and exit criteria, allocate budget, and stop work that is not earning continued investment.
* Lead development programs from concept through prototype, test, military qualification (shock, vibration, and electromagnetic interference), and transition to production.

* Build and manage relationships with engine licensors, technology partners, universities, and government test sites.
* Retrofits & Upgrades
* Own the retrofit and upgrade product line for in-service engines and systems, including fuel system upgrades (common rail and electronic fuel injection), controls modernization, and obsolescence solutions.

Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.
As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. **Come Build with Us**
----------------------

We're an NYC-based team that believes culture, craft, and customer obsession go hand in hand. We show up for each other the same way we show up for the people we serve. We're an office-first company that values in-person collaboration 4 days per week because we believe the best work happens when you can collaborate and brainstorm together in the same room. **The Opportunity**
-------------------

Courier Health is at an inflection point. We exist to get patients faster, better access to life-saving therapies. Patients trust us with their health information, and the pharma companies we serve trust us to protect it. That trust is what lets the mission scale. This role owns that.

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. DawnSecurity is building a next-generation cybersecurity platform. At its core is a hard applied-research problem, and this role owns it: leading our Data Science and Data Engineering team, directing algorithm research, building the models behind the platform, and driving the company's intellectual property.

### **What makes this role different**

This is not a "train a classifier on labeled data" role. The core challenges are:

* Learning without labels. The events that matter most are too rare to train on. Models must be built from structure, statistics, and synthetically generated signal rather than labeled examples.
* Probabilistic modeling over graphs. The problem domain is inherently relational — entities, hierarchies, and connections — and the models must reason over that structure, not just over flat feature vectors.
* Adversarially robust learning. An adversary can influence the data our models learn from. Robustness to manipulation and governed model updates are first-class design constraints.
* Explainability as a requirement. Every score must decompose into a sentence a domain expert can act on. Opaque models that outperform explainable ones by a margin still lose here.
* LLMs as components, not oracles. We use LLMs inside pipelines with statistical quality gates and human-in-the-loop escalation — knowing when not to trust model output is the skill.

### **Core Responsibilities**

### **Research & Modeling Leadership**

* Own the research agenda: from hypothesis through prototype, empirical validation, shadow-mode deployment, and production.
* Design probabilistic and statistical models for sparse, high-cardinality event data — scoring, smoothing, calibration, drift detection.
* Lead graph-based modeling: entity resolution across heterogeneous sources, inference over large graphs, relationship discovery with tiered confidence.
* Combine statistical models with rule- and constraint-based reasoning where the two must agree.
* Define the evaluation discipline: synthetic data, shadow-mode comparisons, calibration audits, and precision targets tied to user trust.

### **IP Creation & Protection**

* Drive patentable inventions from the research roadmap: identify novel mechanisms, validate them empirically, and work with patent counsel on claims.
* Distinguish what to file, what to publish, and what to keep as trade secret — and sequence research disclosures accordingly.

### **Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Architect the sandbox-to-production path: streaming and batch pipelines, feature stores, model serving with low-latency inference at high event throughput.
* Establish MLOps: versioning of code, data, and models; automated validation; monitoring that triggers governed retraining.

We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to own AI platform strategy at Nordstrom.

Internally, we are changing how thousands of Nordstrom employees do their jobs, from how engineers and product managers build software to how merchants, marketers and store teams operate. Externally, we are building the AI our customers experience directly across discovery, shopping and service. Both run on a shared foundation of platforms, tools and standards that have to be safe, usable and adopted at scale.

This leader owns that foundation: the shared AI platform capabilities the rest of the company builds on, so teams are not each solving the same problems from scratch. The scale of AI means some domain-level efforts will always be driven outside this leader’s direct scope, closest to the teams who need it. This role exists to make sure as much of that work as possible runs on common ground, and that the capabilities worth building once get built once and get used everywhere.

In this role, you will also oversee the data analysis and governance of the business, which directly enables the capabilities of the AI we will deploy internally. This leader will guide a team of data analysts and product managers who ensure the right data is available to users at the right time and from the right single sources of truth.

Our mission is to return the atmosphere to 280 ppm CO₂. We convert excess inedible biomass into carbon-rich bio-oil and inject it into underground storage for permanent carbon removal. At scale, we can use bio-oil to make fossil-free iron.
 
Our carbon removal efforts began in 2020 with initial purchases from customers like Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft. Since then, we’ve scaled to thousands of tons of carbon removal, grown to over a hundred employees, and established three locations in San Francisco, Colorado, and Louisiana.

Amazon has committed more than $10 billion to Amazon Leo, a low Earth orbit satellite network designed to bring fast, affordable broadband to customers around the world. Production Operations is where that ambition becomes physical. Every Leo satellite weighs more than 1,000 pounds, contains roughly 4 million individual components, and is designed and built in-house on a 172,000 square foot custom production line in Kirkland, Washington, capable of producing up to five satellite a day. The team completed its 1,000th satellite in September 2026 (https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-builds-satellites), making Leo one of the largest and most advanced satellite production operations in the world.  
From the factory, satellites move to a 100,000 square foot payload processing facility at Kennedy Space Center in Florida that can support three launch campaigns at once, and to launch operations in French Guiana. With more than 80 launches secured across four launch providers, Leo plans to double its launch rate to more than 20 missions in its second year. The organization spans eight sites today across multiple states and ground stations across multiple countries, with more investments coming through in the times ahead.  
This role builds on Amazon's deep operations heritage and takes it to newer heights. You will partner with an organization that brings together aerospace, RF, supply chain and manufacturing experts, recruited from the leading space and defense companies, alongside a skilled hourly production and launch workforce building and launching satellite in clean rooms, across shifts, and on mission-critical launch campaigns. Few people leaders anywhere get to shape all of this at once: precision satellite manufacturing across multiple satellite generations, export-controlled and government production, and Amazon Leo's first employing entity outside the US.  
The people decisions made in the next 18 months will shape this organization for the next decade. As the senior PXT leader for Production Operations, you will make them alongside the VP of Production Operations and the multiple Directors who lead satellite manufacturing, launch operations, supply chain, quality, ground gateways, global trade and compliance, enterprise technology, and Manufacturing Systems Engineering and New Product Introduction. You won't be inheriting a playbook. You'll be writing it.  
What makes this role unique  

* Two talent markets, one interwoven strategy. Build differentiated people programs for a highly technical corporate workforce competing in one of the most constrained talent markets in the world, and for a large, fast growing hourly manufacturing and launch workforce, under a single coherent people strategy.
* Organization design at a defining moment. Shape org design, leadership formation, and succession as the organization scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production

By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.
Why join the Harvard Radcliffe Institute?
The Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University, known colloquially as Harvard Radcliffe Institute, is one of the world’s leading centers for interdisciplinary exploration. We bring together students, scholars, artists, and practitioners to pursue curiosity-driven research, expand human understanding, and grapple with questions that demand insight from across disciplines.
The Fellowship Program annually supports the work of 50 leading artists and scholars. Academic Ventures fosters collaborative research projects and sponsors lectures and conferences that engage scholars with the public. The Schlesinger Library documents the lives of American women of the past and present for the future, furthering the Institute's commitment to women, gender, and society. The Emerging Leaders Program is a youth leadership development program partnering local high school sophomores with Harvard undergraduates in a mentoring relationship.
The Institute’s work is shaped by its history as the former Radcliffe College—a school founded to ensure that the standard of education embodied in Harvard was accessible to women, who were then excluded from the University. But the legacy of Radcliffe College is not simply coeducation at Harvard; it is the recognition that universities will always be greater when they draw wisdom and talent from the widest possible pool.
Take a look at this video to get different staff perspectives on working at Harvard Radcliffe Institute !

Reporting to the Library’s Executive Director, the Head of Technical Services will set and guide the department’s strategic direction, advancing effective, forward-looking approaches to technical services that enhance discovery and ensure timely, user-centered access to the Library’s holdings. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

Repair Engineering is the core technical function for Anduril’s component and hardware in-house maintenance capabilities.

You will create it. Where our Head of MRO is building and running the repair organization itself, this role owns the engineering rigor underneath it: the repair-versus-discard decisions, the maintenance task analyses, the repair procedures and the product support data that determine what gets fixed, how, and at what level. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.  
  
Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.  
  
Within Mission Readiness, our Maintenance Repair & Overhaul (MRO) function provides capability to repair durable products to extend their useful life.  
Repair Engineering is the core technical function for Anduril's component and hardware in-house maintenance capabilities.  
  
**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
We are looking for a Director of Repair Engineering to build, from the ground up, the technical engineering backbone of Anduril's repair function. This discipline is nascent at Anduril today. Production engineers handle returns, but the dedicated practice of assessing acceptable wear, developing non-production repair methods, and determining when a product is 'serviceable but not like new' does not yet exist as a standalone function. You will create it. Where our Head of MRO is building and running the repair organization itself, this role owns the engineering rigor underneath it: the repair-versus-discard decisions, the maintenance task analyses, the repair procedures and the product support data that determine what gets fixed, how, and at what level

About ANELLO:

Founded by pioneers in silicon photonics and navigation sensor technology, ANELLO has developed integrated photonic system-on-chip technology for next generation navigation. ANELLO's SIPHOG™ optical gyroscope is based on its patented photonic integrated circuit technology. Our products are high performance, low-power, much smaller size and weight, at a fraction of the cost of traditional optical gyros used in industrial, aerospace and military applications. They enable reliable and accurate navigation and positioning across autonomous applications and within GPS-denied environments. ANELLO has a growing list of customers in commercial and defense segments and scaling production significantly due in part to contracts in the UAV/USV Defense segments.

The Role:

We are moving our gyroscope and IMU electronics from discrete boards to a single, highly integrated mixed signal ASIC. This chip is the step that takes optical-gyroscope precision into high-volume products. As Director, ASIC Engineering, you will own this chip from definition to production. You will lead the program through a top-tier ASIC design partner to first silicon in less than two years. Then you will build ANELLO's in house ASIC organization and define the chips that follow.

Why This Role:
- Full ownership. One chip, one leader. You make the key decisions, from partner selection to tapeout.
- A hard, interesting chip. Low-noise optical receivers, data converters, precision references, power stages, and an embedded processor that runs the IMU sensor hub, all on one die.
- Build from the ground up. Hire the first engineers, set the flows, and shape the in-house team for future generations.
- Real-world impact. Your silicon goes into navigation systems that people depend on when GPS fails.
- Executive visibility. The ASIC is central to the company roadmap, and you work directly with the leadership team.

What You Will Do:
- Own the ASIC program end to end: scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the tapeout decision.
- Lead vendor selection through RFI, RFP, and RFQ. Select the design partner, the process, and the foundry.
- Lead the design partner at the technical level. Drive the design reviews, and hold a high bar on verification and sign-off.
- Own the specification. Make sure that the ASIC is a drop-in replacement for today's discrete electronics.
- Integrate the work outside the partner's scope: signal-processing RTL, firmware, package, photonics, and test.
- Lead silicon bring-up, characterization, qualification, and the ramp to production.
- Hire a small, strong core team now, and grow it into ANELLO's in-house ASIC organization.

What You Bring:
- BS in Electrical Engineering or a related field. MS or PhD preferred.
- 15+ years in ASIC development, including 5+ years leading ASIC teams or programs.
- Hands-on roots in analog/mixed-signal design or verification. You have designed silicon yourself.
- A record of shipping mixed-signal ASICs from specification to volume

About Anvil

Anvil Capture Systems is a Somerville, MA-based startup commercializing novel carbon dioxide removal technology. Anvil's mineralization-based process is patented, and uniquely measurable, affordable, scalable, and safe, making Anvil a highly competitive entrant in the sector. Anvil is based at Greentown Labs, the largest climate tech incubator in the world, with operations in Québec, Canada.

 

The Role

Reporting directly to Anvil's co-founders, the Director of Engineering will lead Anvil's commercial pilot project installation in Québec, and will help to design and scale the bulk material handling and downstream processing technology at the core of Anvil's process.  - Lead facility commissioning and startup as Anvil's on-site technical supervisor

 - Degree in mechanical or chemical engineering; a mechanical engineering foundation combined with surface mining and mineral processing experience

 - Direct commissioning and startup experience on new plants

 - Comfort in a small, fast-moving startup environment; prior early-stage company experience is a strong plus

 - Ready for regular travel between Boston and time spent on field sites in Québec and elsewhere

 

Nice to Haves

 - Process modeling tools; CAD experience (SolidWorks, AutoCAD)

Compensation

Competitive base salary + equity. Relocation support available.

WSP is seeking a Project Manager to manage projects for our Power Testing and Energization (PTE) group within the POWER Delivery Department. This position is posted in multiple Regional Office Locations with the ability to work remotely from a mutually acceptable location (please note in the application questions where you prefer to be located). The candidate selected for this position may work remotely full-time at a location other than a WSP designated office/job site. Employees may travel to a WSP office for periodic meetings.
Your Impact
We are looking for candidates with strong business acumen, business development experience (must be a Seller/Doer) and must have a solid background in electrical testing and commissioning. This is a very fast-paced job working on several short-term or long-term projects at a time that may last from a day to several weeks/months in duration.  This position will manage various types of testing projects including distribution, transmission and substation projects.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing technical and financial aspects of PTE projects with responsibilities including, but not limited to:

•    Manage project implementation including project schedule, project budget and the project resources including external vendors and contractors
•    Serve as the primary project authority for assigned project personnel on major project-related issues
•    Direct project team and lead the project management process
•    Responsible for metrics tracking, associated reporting to stakeholders, and compliance with regulatory, corporate and department procedures during all the phases of the project
•    Taking a significant role in business development and preparing proposals
•    Developing scope of work criteria, budgets, schedules, and related project documents
•    Managing testing services on electric utility systems from 15kV to 765 kV class
•    Providing internal mentoring and leadership to junior team members

Job Description
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Director, Transformation & Corporate Strategy to join our ever evolving team and help shape the future of global commerce.

Global Payments' Transformation Office is a central, enterprise-wide function based in the company's Atlanta headquarters that partners closely with executive leadership to drive integration, growth, operating model, and cost transformation across the firm. The Transformation Office works across business units and functions to translate strategic priorities into executable transformation programs, establish enterprise transformation frameworks and operating cadence, and ensure disciplined value realization. The team partners with business unit, regional, and functional leadership to design scalable operating models, enable successful integration and separation, and drive sustainable growth and cost efficiency.

This role will be located at our Buckhead location in Atlanta, GA

What You Will Own
The Director, Transformation and Corporate Strategy is a leader within the Transformation Office, supporting the leader heading Corporate Strategy in Transformation Office and other senior transformation leaders on enterprise strategy, operating model, and transformation initiatives. Transformation Office is responsible for framing and solving the enterprise's hardest structural questions: where the operating model should change, how the organization should be designed to deliver it, and what it takes to make the change stick. The role suits an engagement manager from a top-tier consulting firm who wants to lead projects end to end, from problem definition and hypothesis development through analysis, recommendation, executive alignment, and implementation.

Problem structuring and engagement leadership:
- Translate ambiguous executive questions into defined workstreams with hypotheses, work plans, analytical approaches, and milestones.
- Target operating model design: lead operating model work across organization structure, governance, decision rights, capabilities, processes, service delivery, technology enablement, and performance management.
- Strategy development: evaluate growth, portfolio, product, market, and business model choices, and develop the fact base and reasoning that support a clear strategic direction.
- Structural alternatives: assess centralization, decentralization, shared services, centers of excellence, outsourcing, insourcing, and consolidation options, weighing cost, capability, risk, and speed rather than cost alone.
- Executive advisory and storylining: partner with senior executives to frame tradeoffs, challenge assumptions, and build synthesized recommendations for leadership forums.

Implementation and change:
- Translate recommendations into roadmaps, workstream charters, and adoption plans, and work with business leaders through the stakeholder, capability, and change management
